paragraphs.source_en: “Shh—” Torii Hikoemon hastily silenced him. Only then did everyone notice that Motoyasu’s eyes were tightly shut, his lips pressed firmly together. Thirteen years of life as a hostage had finally ended, and the freedom long denied him had arrived. Yet the only space in which he was free was Ōdaka, an isolated castle encircled on every side by enemies…

paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu casually raised his eyes to the sky. The dark clouds had dispersed and countless stars glittered; suddenly, a meteor fell toward the southern sea. In this vast world there was not even a patch of ground where the people of Okazaki could stand—he felt the cruelty of fate keenly, yet he did not despair. So perilous was his position that he almost wanted to laugh.

paragraphs.source_en: No one present could find an answer. A night assault on Kiyosu Castle! Kiyosu Castle, now immersed in celebration, might well have left itself exposed. But was there truly any need to attack Kiyosu Castle for the sake of Yoshimoto, who had subjected the people of Okazaki to endless abuse? That doubt lay in every man’s heart. Motoyasu knew it perfectly well. At last, he spoke what was truly in his heart.
